# Updated Fire Door Certification Standard

Published ahead of schedule by BWF, the updated version of its FDT certification covers doors with glass vision panels, fire dampers and fire-rated doorsets with frames other than made of timber or steel.

Industry-wide efforts have transformed the fire-resistant door certification process in the UK and Ireland, and the updated standards cover a much wider range of compliant products.
